_comment: One object per research direction, rendered on /research/ in the order listed, each separated by a hairline rule. Fields: title, paragraphs (an array — one entry per paragraph), image (path under /assets/, blank shows a placeholder) and alt (describes the figure for screen readers).

topics.title: AI-enabled Pipelines
paragraphs: Developing and implementing AI-enabled wet-dry integrated laboratory pipelines for cancer research to streamline multi-omics data processing and accelerate mechanistic discovery.

topics.title: lncRNA–protein Complexes
paragraphs: Characterizing the roles and regulatory mechanisms of lncRNA–protein complexes in controlling gene expression during X chromosome inactivation (XCI) and paraspeckles formation, using AI-assisted target quantification and computational modeling.

topics.title: Oncohistone H2B
paragraphs: Deciphering how H2B oncohistones drive tumorigenesis, and leveraging CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing platform for identifying therapeutic candidates.

topics.title: In-vivo genome-wide editing and screening platforms
paragraphs: Developing novel genome-wide CRISPR editing and screening platforms in living animals to advance translational relevance in cancer research.
